last_completed_unit.target: Cargo target.<triple>.<links> override portability and completeness limits
last_completed_unit.finding: Cargo documents build-script overrides under target.<triple>.<links>, making the documented override target-triple-specific. The override can predeclare rustc-link-lib, rustc-link-search, rustc-flags, rustc-cfg, rustc-env, rustc-cdylib-link-arg and arbitrary links metadata. Cargo explicitly says warning, rerun-if-changed and rerun-if-env-changed are ignored in overrides. Other recognized build-script instructions such as rustc-check-cfg and generic/per-target-category rustc-link-arg variants are not exposed as documented override keys. Build scripts may also create OUT_DIR artifacts for native compilation or code generation, which a metadata-only override does not create.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Current official Cargo Book Configuration and Build Scripts documentation; no Cargo execution and no specific crate tested.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Undocumented-key parser behavior across Cargo versions, specific-crate correctness, native/generated artifact availability, build-dependency pruning, actual compilation or end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main freshness checks, and official Cargo Configuration plus Build Scripts documentation only.
scope_guard: Do not generalize the documented target-triple override into proof that a single portable entry covers all targets, that arbitrary build-script instructions are representable, or that native/code-generated artifacts can be replaced by metadata alone.

frontier.current_target: Determine whether overriding a links build script also eliminates compilation of that build script and its build-dependencies from the Cargo unit graph.
frontier.next_unit: After fresh required-control bootstrap and SHA-only head validation, read only official Cargo source/docs needed to determine whether a target.<triple>.<links> override causes the build script and its build-dependencies to be omitted from compilation or only suppresses execution. Keep specific-crate correctness, native/generated artifacts and actual build execution unresolved; do not run Cargo.

exact_continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and SHA-only validate current authority, then run one bounded official-source leaf on build-dependency behavior when a links build script is overridden: determine from Cargo source/docs whether the build script and its build-dependencies are omitted from the unit graph/compilation or merely the script execution is suppressed. Keep specific-crate correctness, native/generated artifact creation and actual compilation unresolved; do not run Cargo or start a second leaf.
